description:
This video explains how to understand a business through four lenses: accounting, unit economics, cash, and capital allocation. It emphasizes that no single financial metric can capture a firm's performance and that these complementary views are necessary to build a traceable chain from customer demand to investment decisions.

title: Understanding Business Performance: 4 Lenses
